title: Bellbird Bay Rising Again
author: Ivo Quintana
blurb: Oscar Coldharbour, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
